protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: GHSA-3j3q-wp9x-585p (published, withdrawn_at null) and CVE-2026-39429 (CVE.org/cveawg state PUBLISHED) describe the same live bug: the root shard mounts the embedded cache handler at /services/cache/ on preHandlerChainMux, which is assembled in pkg/server/config.go before DefaultBuildHandlerChainFromAuthz/BeforeAuthz so the path never hits shard authn/authz; pkg/cache/server/options/options.go Complete() also does `o.Authentication = nil` and `o.Authorization = nil` (TODO: enable authN/Z stack). At 44b4682b63e6edbc4f63014adfa27d395ea958c2, pkg/server/cache.go registers preparedCacheServer.Handler on s.preHandlerChainMux at virtualcommandoptions.DefaultRootPathPrefix+"/cache/" where DefaultRootPathPrefix is "/services". Unauthenticated reads of replicated objects and short-lived RBAC writes into shared cache informers follow from that sink. Not withdrawn/rejected.
